claimChecks.claim: All Y-V repairs have the same geometry, pedicle and predictable length gain
claimChecks.locator: Page geometry/formula versus cited cutaneous model and GU technique descriptions
claimChecks.note: Equation scoped to multiple cutaneous design; no universal perfusion/full-thickness/length rule.

claimChecks.claim: Two prior failed BNC treatments define refractory disease and open Y-V gives 100% durable cure
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Methods, Results and follow-up
claimChecks.note: Two failures were enrollment; 18/18 no further instrumentation at mean 14.8 months, with 61% storage symptoms.

claimChecks.claim: Zang proves faster, less leaky laparoscopic Y-V than open repair
claimChecks.note: No controlled comparison established by cited technical report.

claimChecks.claim: Abramowitz is endoscopic bladder-wall Y-V with durable 89–100% success
claimChecks.locator: 2021 original abstract Methods/Results; 2026 successor cohort abstract
claimChecks.note: Transurethral incision/transverse mucosal realignment is distinct; 2021 median follow-up only six months; larger 2026 series requires separate review.

claimChecks.claim: Y-V is equivalent to Anderson-Hynes and crossing vessels contraindicate Y-V
claimChecks.note: 86% vs 95% nonsignificant does not prove equivalence; crossing vessel was more frequent in Y-V arm, so blanket contraindication removed.

claimChecks.claim: Y-V meatoplasty has 96.5% unrestricted long-term success
claimChecks.note: 55/57 symptom relief, selected retrospective group, six with less than one-year follow-up.

claimChecks.claim: Robotic Y-V has a universal continence preservation rate and ICG shortens its learning curve
claimChecks.locator: Original abstracts outcomes and operative descriptions
claimChecks.note: Different baseline/definitions, small cohorts, and ICG used for localization but learning-curve effect unproven.
